purpose: Approval of Bella Duration maths, correctly linked DF and genuine-absence/damage display policy.
status: Approved requirements; independent implementation, format/edge coverage and cutover are still future work.
authorization: OK, let's lock this in for Bella: keep the verified Duration maths, use the correctly linked drop-frame flag, use NDF if genuinely missing, and leave Duration blank if damaged. What's next?

agreedBellaRule.maths: Carry verified count/rate preservation and integer/fraction calculation rules and useful test cases into fresh small Bella helpers; do not patch OldScanner into Bella.
agreedBellaRule.durationSource: Own MDB descriptor Length and SampleRate remain paired and preserved; no header read or header repair for Duration, including its numbering.
agreedBellaRule.audioDisplay: Use the discussed qualified own-file MDB editing clock for audio frame presentation. Preserve samples and original fractions; convert with checked exact arithmetic and round only the final frame quotient, nearest with positive halves upward.
agreedBellaRule.rateMeaning: Use the discussed source-aware supported Avid editing-rate interpretation without changing original source values or aliasing audio sampling frequency; native video conversion proof does not claim the complete native audio UI path.
agreedBellaRule.format: HH:MM:SS:FF with colons; explicit supported nominal base only for numbering. Audio visible Frame Rate stays blank.
agreedBellaRule.dfAssociation: Use only correctly linked applicable timecode, including an explicitly associated source record when required, with source-track/kind/position/span and compatible clock qualification. Do not sweep all reachable TCCPs.
agreedBellaRule.dfLayout: Legacy supported Flags bit0; separately typed OMF2 Boolean Drop. Do not reject a valid legacy word solely because higher bits exist.
agreedBellaRule.dfMode: Use compatible recorded DF/NDF; do not infer DF from29.97/59.94. Supported NDF-only clocks need no DF lookup.
agreedBellaRule.genuinelyMissing: After complete supported lookup, use NDF as explicit fallback while preserving absence distinct from recorded false.
agreedBellaRule.damaged: Required damaged/contradictory/unsafe timing or applicable numbering leaves formatted Duration blank, retaining independently valid exact data and physical file.
agreedBellaRule.applicability: Clearly unrelated different-clock source timecode cannot override or blank a known NDF-only Duration. Broken references do not establish genuine absence.
agreedBellaRule.zeroAndLong: Established zero displays00:00:00:00, valid positive durations rounded tozero also displayzero while preserving samples; hours can exceed24. Unknown required values do not become numeric zero.
agreedBellaRule.notStartTimecode: Do not add StartTC or replace physical Length with editorial/source/master lengths.
agreedBellaRule.runtimeDesign: Compact selected values and availability/reason status, scoped temporary parsing, no permanent comparison graph solely for Duration.

supersedes: Earlier proposed/pending status for the discussed audio display design, verified rounding and detailed linked DF/absence/damage policy in historical evidence and reports.

remaining.nextReview: General MDB structural damage/missing-reference handling, then supported layouts/versions.
remaining.coverage: Safe supported CPNT/MSLT/reference/span layouts, uncommon rates, checked overflow, zero/missing and malformed fixtures are implementation verification work; no automatic claim of support for unobserved forms.
remaining.presentation: Duration sorting and CSV details remain separate presentation work.
remaining.later: Review media-header capabilities, then consolidate the full priority table at the end as requested before implementation/design completion.

validation.scope: Approval/requirements documentation and JSON only; existing raw/native/corpus research receipts preserved.

supersededInPartBy.scope: Only the blanket MDB-only Duration source restriction is superseded by the approved database-unavailable MXF fallback. Original authorization, findings and other rules remain historical and unchanged.
